name: Bulk product actions
description:
##  POST /api/v1/products/bulk
Archive / Restore / Delete  / Set tax id in bulk
whenToUse: Run a named action over many product ids at once (archive, restore, delete, set tax); use for batch operations, not single edits (mutating).

queryParameters.name: index
queryParameters.description:
Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string

ie.

```html
  ?index=new_index
```

response is wrapped

```json
  {
    'new_index' : [
      .....
    ]
  }
```

fields.name: action
fields.description: The action to perform ie. archive / restore / delete / set_tax_id

fields.name: tax_id
fields.description:
